source: OpenStreetMap (natural=coastline) via Overpass, OR derived from the ESA WorldCover water class, OR OSM-derived global coastline extracts (e.g. OSMcoastline project)
download_date: NOT DOWNLOADED (Overpass query limitation, same as roads/buildings - see scripts/download_roads.sh, same pattern applies)
coverage: Mumbai + buffer coastline (Arabian Sea, Thane Creek, Mahim Bay, Mithi River estuary)
quality: medium-high (OSM coastline is generally well mapped for India's west coast)
limitations: OSM coastline is a modeled/traced line, not a surveyed MHW/MLW line; for engineering-grade tidal datum lines, INCOIS/Survey of India charts would be needed (see below).
notes: For a more authoritative coastline, Survey of India (surveyofindia.gov.in) publishes coastal maps but interactive/paid access - not confirmed freely bulk-downloadable in this session.
